visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up of a black sizzling iron plate filled with raw Wagyu beef slices, half a lobster, scallops, and broccoli. Dense steam rises from the food, indicating high heat. The table setting is clean and brightly lit. (2) A green plate holds several slices of pink ham topped with bright orange sea urchin sauce and julienned onions. A pair of hands using wooden chopsticks rolls a slice of ham around the toppings. The background is a blurred restaurant interior. (3) A woman with her hair tied back, wearing a black hoodie, is seen from the chest up, smiling as she eats. The restaurant interior features warm wooden walls, a large mural of a pine tree, and red cushioned chairs. (4) A waiter's hands place a sizzling plate of sliced Wagyu beef and a small dish of sauce on the wooden table. The beef is topped with a cube of yellow butter which begins to melt. The scene transition focuses on the meat's texture. (5) The woman clinks a glass of red wine with another person's drink and takes a sip. In the background, a projection of a traditional Japanese performer appears on a screen. The lighting is warm and ambient. (6) Chopsticks flip the beef slices on the sizzling iron plate, showing the transition from raw pink to cooked brown. Sliced garlic and onions are visible underneath the meat. (7) A piece of cooked beef is dipped into a bowl of dark soy sauce. Then, a piece of meat is placed on a bowl of steaming white rice. The focus is tight on the food's texture and color. (8) The woman is shown dining while looking towards a stage area where a blue-toned projection of a traditional dancer is performing. The room is spacious with a sophisticated, upscale atmosphere. (9) A montage displays the full meal: a small salad, an appetizer of sashimi, the main Wagyu and lobster course, and a dessert plate with a pink macaron and chocolate tart. (10) The camera shows a private tatami room with sliding paper doors and then moves to the exterior of the 'Sanda-ya' restaurant and the Shinsaibashi PARCO mall entrance. A final slide shows a promotional coupon for the restaurant.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: 日本失心瘋 @japanuts. (2) [Subtitle]: 神戶牛真的太美味 來到關西不能不品嚐. (3) [Subtitle]: 這次也吃到令人驚艷 超級好吃的火腿冷盤. (4) [Subtitle]: 夾上洋蔥和醬料 吃起來好爽口. (5) [Subtitle]: 這次來到 三田屋本店 安逸之鄉 心齋橋PARCO店. (6) [Subtitle]: 店內環境非常雅緻 桌距不會太近, 很舒適. (7) [Subtitle]: 點了經典的和牛牛排. (8) [Subtitle]: 哇~熱騰騰的鐵板上桌!. (9) [Subtitle]: 朋友點的和牛 & 國產牛菲力. (10) [Subtitle]: 低溫調理過的色澤 看起來就好好吃. (11) [Subtitle]: 先來乾杯. [Variety]: ※未成年請勿飲酒, 喝酒不開車※. (12) [Subtitle]: 可以利用鐵板 調整成自己喜歡的熱度. (13) [Subtitle]: 搭上蒜片, 絕配!. (14) [Subtitle]: 店家推薦沾醋吃 也別有一番風味. (15) [Subtitle]: 米飯採用丹波筱山的白米 吃起來圓潤又Q彈, 口感非常好. (16) [Subtitle]: 海鮮也都很美味. (17) [Subtitle]: 很棒的用餐體驗. (18) [Subtitle]: 特別是很少見能倒投影的表演 一邊用餐一邊欣賞, 非常特殊. (19) [Subtitle]: 這一餐 從前菜, 冷盤, 主餐到甜點 我覺得都很不錯, 是一次特別的體驗. (20) [Subtitle]: 店家也有榻榻米包廂 多人用餐也很適合. (21) [Subtitle]: 地點在心齋橋PARCO 13樓 推薦大家有機會可以試試. (22) [Slogan]: 歡迎截圖優惠券 三田屋本店 限定優惠券.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Upbeat acoustic guitar and piano BGM starts immediately. A dominant, high-energy sizzling sound (SFX) with broad spectral bandwidth fills the mix for 2 seconds, representing the hot iron plate. (2) The sizzling fades, leaving the bouncy, major-key BGM as the primary layer. The rhythm is steady and light, around 124 BPM. (3) A new burst of sizzling SFX occurs as another dish is presented, competing momentarily with the music's volume. (4) A sharp, high-pitched 'clink' SFX of a glass toast occurs over the BGM, followed by another sustained sizzling sound as food is cooked. (5) The BGM continues smoothly without interruption or vocal overlays. No speech or singing is present in the entire track. (6) The video concludes with the BGM fading out. The overall mix is clean, emphasizing the textural food sounds alongside the pleasant, upbeat music.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: A travel and food vlog designed to recommend the 'Sanda-ya Honten' restaurant in Osaka's Shinsaibashi PARCO. It highlights the high quality of Wagyu beef and seafood, the unique dining atmosphere with projections, and provides a discount coupon to encourage viewers to visit.
